About Hemab

Hemab is building preventative treatments for serious, underserved bleeding disorders. These are therapies designed to work with the body's own biology and stop bleeds before they start, instead of treating them after they happen. We're patient-first, science-led and clinical-stage - with a pipeline that takes different scientific approaches to different patient needs.

We went public via our 2026 IPO, and we're scaling across two homes: Cambridge, MA, USA, and Copenhagen, Denmark.

The role

As Director, Clinical Sciences, you'll help turn Hemab's science into well-designed clinical studies and clear evidence about how our treatments perform in patients. You'll take scientific ownership across protocol development, study execution and data interpretation, working closely with Medical Directors and colleagues across clinical development, regulatory and other functions.

What you'll do

• Lead the clinical science contribution to study strategy, design and execution, keeping the scientific questions and patient needs at the centre of decisions.

• Drive protocol development with the Medical Director, including amendments as emerging data or study needs require.

• Own the scientific review of clinical study data, identify discrepancies and trends, and turn emerging safety and efficacy data into clear questions and actions for the team.

• Shape study documents and plans, including informed consent forms, eCRFs, medical monitoring plans and data review plans.

• Guide sites and vendors on protocol requirements, eligibility criteria and participant management so studies are executed consistently and to the intended design.

• Partner across clinical development to analyse and interpret study results and build a clear understanding of what the data mean.

• Translate study findings for internal and external audiences alongside the Medical Director.

• Develop clinical content for regulatory documents, including investigator brochures, annual safety reports, clinical study reports and registration submissions.

What you'll bring to Hemab

• Substantial clinical science or clinical research experience in drug development, with direct responsibility for clinical studies.

• Experience developing clinical protocols and interpreting safety and efficacy data from interventional studies.

• A strong working knowledge of ICH-GCP, clinical study design and drug development in a regulated environment.

• The scientific judgement to interpret clinical information, literature and changing treatment approaches and apply it to study and development decisions.

• Experience working effectively with investigators, vendors and cross-functional clinical, medical and regulatory colleagues.

Nice to have

• Experience in haematology, rare disease or bleeding disorders.

• Experience contributing to development programmes through later-stage studies and registration.

• An advanced scientific or clinical degree.

What to expect, honestly

Hemab is still building a lot of its own structure. Systems here tend to get created as we need them, not handed down in advance. Whoever takes this role will likely build some of their own process instead of inheriting a finished one. We work across two hubs and multiple time zones - bridging that well takes real, deliberate effort. And because we're growing quickly, priorities can shift with less notice than they would at a larger, more established company.

This is the actual shape of working somewhere at this stage: It's genuinely energising for the right person and genuinely frustrating for the wrong one. If you want a place where the operating manual is already written, this might not be it – but if you want to help write it, this might be exactly it.

Why Hemab

At Hemab, your work ultimately connects back to something simple. People living with serious bleeding disorders get something they've never had before - the chance to prevent a bleed, instead of reacting to one after it happens. You'll be joining at a stage where individual decisions still carry real weight, and where your work can help turn promising science into a preventative treatment that actually reaches patients.

How we treat our people is meant to be an extension of how we think about patients: with care, honesty, and respect. We're still building the consistency to back that up across every hiring process, every time. We'd say that plainly instead of pretending otherwise. If any part of your experience with us falls short of it, tell us.

Hemab builds balanced candidate slates and assesses everyone against a single standard. If you need a reasonable adjustment at any stage of the hiring process, please tell us.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Hemab Therapeutics is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, seeking to create a welcoming and diverse environment. All applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, pregnancy, sex, marital status, gender expression or identity, genetic information, sexual orientation, citizenship, or any other legally protected class.

At Trustpilot, we're on an incredible journey. We're a profitable, high-growth FTSE-250 company with a big vision: to become the universal symbol of trust. We run the world's largest open customer review platform, and while we've come a long way, there's still so much exciting work to do. Come join us at the heart of trust!

In this role, you will join the growth team in building best-in-class experiences that drive product-led growth. If you are excited about driving innovation, eager to take ownership of significant projects, and keen on making a global impact, this is the opportunity you've been waiting for.

Join Trustpilot's Product Management team and play an integral part in shaping the future of our dynamic and rapidly growing organization. Together, let's push the boundaries of what's possible in the Product space and create a lasting impact on our customers worldwide.

What you’ll be doing:

• Leading a cross-functional team to deliver high-quality experiences that lead to desired outcomes

• Build out PLG strategy in partnership with Product, Monetisation, Marketing and Commercial teams

• Collaborating with your team and others to think big and imagine future solutions to solve problems

• Run experiments to increase targeted outcomes and share those learnings across the company

• Partner with analytics and research to better understand what drives your targeted outcomes; be a subject matter expert on the topic

• Contribute to the continuous development of our overarching growth product strategy

• Taking ownership of the product roadmap and backlog, and ensuring that they are aligned with business goals and customer needs

• Conducting research and interacting regularly with customers to gain knowledge about the problems you are solving and defining and framing these problems with your team

• Building relationships with stakeholders in sales, marketing, and customer success and promoting product-thinking throughout the organisation

• Communicating product plans, status, and issues to internal stakeholders and executive leadership

• Motivating your team and colleagues to produce their best work possible.

Who you are:

• Proven history of delivering tangible business outcomes

• Good communication skills and proven history of effective collaboration with cross-functional product teams

• Passion for delivering high-quality experiences that solve customer problems and drive business impact

• Comprehensive understanding of product management principles and processes, including product strategy, product roadmap development, and agile development methodologies

• Analytical mindset and can leverage data to inform your product decisions as well as establish metrics and OKRs to measure product success

• Friendly, knowledgeable, open-minded, collaborative and able to motivate and inspire others.

• Experience in B2B or SaaS products is desirable

• Experience working on a Growth team is desirable

What’s in it for you:

• A range of flexible working options to dedicate time to what matters to you

• Competitive compensation package + bonus

• 25 days holiday per year, with an extra 5 days holiday allocated after your 1 year anniversary (prorated)

• Two (paid) volunteering days a year to spend your time giving back to the causes that matter to you and your community

• Rich learning and development opportunities are supported through the Trustpilot Academy and Blinkist

• Comprehensive health package, pension, and full access to Headspace, a popular mindfulness app to promote positive mental health

• Paid parental leave

• Central office with  a laid-back vibe and constant buzz of different languages being spoken everywhere you go It’s complete with a coffee bar, canteen, and table tennis and has a wide variety of refreshments available - you can opt-in for breakfast and lunch at an affordable price

• Regular opportunities to connect and get to know your fellow Trusties, including company-wide celebrations and events, ERG activities, and team socials

• Opportunity to join the Trustpilot Social Club for a small monthly fee and attend regular social and leisure activities like go-karting, cooking classes, and escape rooms

• Employee discounts to restaurants and shops

Still not sure?

We want to be a part of creating a more diverse, equitable, and inclusive world of work for all. We’re excited to hear about your experiences along with how you will contribute to our working culture. Even if you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, we'd still really like to hear from you!

About us

Trustpilot began in 2007 with a simple yet powerful idea that is more relevant today than ever — to be the universal symbol of trust, bringing consumers and businesses together through reviews. Trustpilot is open, independent, and impartial — we help consumers make the right choices and businesses to build trust, grow and improve.

Today, we have more than 350 million reviews and 60 million monthly active users across the globe, with 149 billion annual Trustpilot brand impressions, and the numbers keep growing. We have more than 1000 employees and we’re headquartered in Copenhagen, with operations in  Amsterdam, Denver, Edinburgh, Hamburg, London, Melbourne, Milan and New York.

We’re driven by connection. It’s at the heart of what we do. Our culture keeps things fresh –– it’s built on the relationships we create. We talk, we laugh, we collaborate and we respect each other. We work across borders and cultures to be the universal symbol of trust in an ever-changing world. With vibrant office locations worldwide and over 50 nationalities, we’re proud to be an equal opportunity workplace with diverse perspectives and ideas.

Our purpose to help people and businesses help each other is a tall order, but we keep it real. We’re a great bunch of humans, doing awesome stuff, without fuss or pretense. A successful Trustpilot future is driven by you –– we give you the autonomy to shape a career you can be proud of. If you’re ready to grow, let’s go.

Join us at the heart of trust.

Trustpilot is committed to creating an inclusive environment where people from all backgrounds can thrive and where different viewpoints and experiences are valued and respected. Trustpilot will consider all applications for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, national origin, religious beliefs, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, neurodiversity, disability, age, parental or veteran status. Together, we are the heart of trust.

• Significant product management experience working within agile teams, with a proven history of driving significant business impact and delivering effective products

• Comprehensive understanding of product management principles, including setting long-term product strategy, owning roadmap development, and agile methodologies

• Demonstrated experience working in cross-functional teams and successfully influencing senior leadership and executive stakeholders, without direct authority

• Expertise in user research, A/B testing, and data analysis to independently define strategic direction and product development

• Skilled in critical assessment and oversight, with expertise in defining, setting up, and supervising key performance indicators and measures of achievement

• Passion for emerging technologies and their potential to transform the product area and user experience

• Great communication and executive-level stakeholder management skills, with the ability to align diverse teams around a common, long-term vision

• A range of flexible working options to dedicate time to what matters to you

• Competitive compensation package + bonus

• 25 days holiday per year, increasing to 28 days after 2 years of employment

• Two (paid) volunteering days a year to spend your time giving back to the causes that matter to you and your community

• Rich learning and development opportunities are supported through the Trustpilot Academy and Blinkist

• Pension and life insurance

• Health cash plan, online GP, 24/7 Employee Assistance Plan

• Full access to Headspace, a popular mindfulness app to promote positive mental health

• Paid parental leave

• Season ticket loan and a cycle-to-work scheme

We're looking for senior consultants to take a leading role in complex ERP transformation projects across ERP strategy, programme management, solution architecture, and functional consulting.

What you’ll do

You will take a leading role in some of the largest ERP transformations across Europe. Depending on your profile and development goals, your responsibilities may include:

· Shaping ERP strategies and road maps, system and vendor selections, enterprise solution architecture, and scope definition and value cases, including RISE with SAP and Clean Core positioning

· Programme design, mobilisation and planning, programme and project management, PMO setup and operation, and independent programme assurance, using SAP Activate, Success by Design, or similar as well as Implement’s Half Double methodology

· Business process mapping and design, process optimisation, fit-gap analysis and requirements gathering, facilitation of key design decisions (KDDs), and test design and execution support

· Data migration and transformation (ETL), data cleansing and quality assurance, data governance and operating models, and platform data model design – including MDM concepts and cutover planning

· Advising CxO-level stakeholders, facilitating decision forums and steering committees, and coaching less experienced colleagues

Our projects typically combine process design, solution architecture, complex stakeholder management, and change management. As a senior consultant, you will often be the one holding the pen on the overall design and the client relationship. AI is part of our daily life at Implement. We use it actively in how we analyse, design, build, and deliver, and you’ll be expected to embrace it as a natural part of your consulting toolkit.

What you'll bring

Ideally, you have 5+ years of experience from ERP consulting, including participation in at least one full-cycle implementation (SAP S/4HANA/ECC or Microsoft D365 F&O). In addition, we'd prefer candidates who:

· Bring deep functional and process expertise, especially within SAP S/4HANA, in one or more areas such as finance and controlling (FI/CO, Margin Analysis), order to cash (SD), procure to pay (MM/Ariba), plan to fulfil (DM/PP/QM), warehousing and logistics (EWM/TM), or master data management – or bring strong Microsoft D365 F&O expertise (finance, supply chain, or architecture) and the ambition to further develop this area

· Have experience leading programmes, projects, or PMOs, or acting as enterprise/solution architect, in complex ERP transformations

· Are a strong communicator who can structure and facilitate presentations and workshops in English – German or a Scandinavian language is an additional advantage

What we offer

You'll join a fast-growing, entrepreneurial Scandinavian consultancy, working side by side with some of the strongest ERP transformation profiles in the Nordics – and, on platform-heavy delivery, with our technological sister company, The Tech Collective.

We're a practice with one of the strongest growth journeys at Implement, built on a unique culture, helpful colleagues, and a shared ambition to do consulting differently. With us, you'll have plenty of opportunities to grow professionally and personally, through internal training, certifications, keynotes, and workshops, along with the freedom to shape your own career and choose your own leaders.

The position is based at our office in Hellerup, with flexibility and occasional travel to clients across the Nordics and Europe. The starting date is flexible for the right candidates.

About Implement Consulting Group

Implement Consulting Group (founded 1996) is an international management consultancy with over 2,000 employees, making it one of the largest European consultancies. Headquartered in Copenhagen, the company has 12 offices across the Nordics, the DACH region, and the United States. Implement supports organisations in delivering sustainable strategic, commercial, and operational transformations. The company combines analytical rigour, functional expertise, and industry insight with a unique collaborative model and an ability to engage and mobilise client organisations.

How to apply

· Submit your CV and a brief motivation (max. 200 words). Please indicate which profile(s) you see yourself in

· Include your earliest possible start date

Application deadline

· Ongoing interviews; apply as soon as possible

jobs.description:
Do you enjoy working in a collaborative, cross functional environment where you can support strategic projects and contribute to meaningful solutions that improve the lives of people with intimate healthcare needs? Then this Student Assistant position in Continence Care Pipeline & Portfolio could be the perfect opportunity to kick-start your career.

Join Us: Continence Care Pipeline & Portfolio

At our headquarters in Humlebæk, you will join the Continence Care Pipeline & Portfolio team. Our team manages and owns the full product lifecycle in Continence Care, from early idea generation and innovation through global market launch to product discontinuation. Our work spans short-, mid-, and long-term innovation initiatives, as well as lifecycle management of existing solutions.

We are commercially driven, with our users at the heart of everything we do. Every day, we work to make bladder management easier for our users, believing that strong commercial decisions and deep user understanding go hand in hand.

Build your commercial understanding and competencies

As a Student Assistant, you will work approximately 15–20 hours per week and support the team across a variety of activities. You will gain exposure to a broad range of topics by collaborating closely with experienced colleagues across functions, supporting portfolio and pipeline initiatives, and contributing to projects that help shape the future of Continence Care.

The role offers:

•  Valuable insight into the product lifecycle and commercial decision-making

•  Cross-functional collaboration in a global healthcare company

•  A unique opportunity to build deep business understanding

•  A strong platform to advance your career within Coloplast

Your key focus will be to support the team's activities and contribute to projects that drive innovation and portfolio development in Continence Care. Tasks will vary but are likely to include:

•  Supporting the development of competitive product positioning and claims for marketing and sales activities

•  Collecting and analysing customer feedback and market insights

•  Supporting commercial forecasting activities across innovation projects

•  Assisting with day-to-day team activities, including maintaining SharePoint content, managing product samples, and supporting workshops

You will also have the opportunity to be part of Coloplast Young Professionals, a community where students and early-career colleagues connect, network and participate in both professional and social events across the organization.

We imagine that you:

•  Are currently studying a bachelor's or master’s degree within business, marketing, innovation or a related field

•  Have strong organisational skills and enjoy coordinating tasks across different projects

•  Possess strong analytical skills and enjoy working with data, including Excel

•  Take ownership of your work and follow through on your commitments

•  Are fluent in English, Danish is not required

•  Possibly have some first working experience

On top of that you are curious and eager to learn, always looking to develop new skills and take on new challenges. You enjoy working in an international environment, collaborating with colleagues across functions, and contributing ideas that help move projects forward.

Interested?

For more information, contact Christina Sommer, Senior Product Manager Pipeline & Portfolio, at dkcsom@coloplast.com.

We will review candidates on an ongoing basis, so please apply as soon as possible.

Pursuing an ambitious growth agenda, Coloplast develops and markets products and services that make life easier for people with intimate healthcare needs. Employing about 16.000 people and with products available in more than 143 countries, we are one of the world´s leading medical device companies. We are constantly growing our business and always looking for new ways to move forward – we explore, learn and look for new ways of doing things.

Coloplast is committed to being an inclusive organization, where people bring their differences to work each day, fulfil their potential and have a strong sense of belonging because – and not despite – of their differences. We therefore encourage all qualified candidates to apply regardless of gender, age, race, nationality, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religious belief or physical ability.

Visit us on Coloplast.com.

Watch the film. Follow us on LinkedIn.

Service Owner, Collaboration & Productivity

Would you like to shape the services that help colleagues communicate, collaborate and work productively every day?

As Service Owner, Collaboration & Productivity, you’ll take end-to-end ownership of these services at GlobalConnect, with Microsoft 365 at the center of your portfolio.

You’ll combine service reliability and governance with the opportunity to shape how our collaboration and productivity services develop over time.

To thrive in this role, you’ll likely bring:

• Several years of experience as a Service Owner, Application Owner, Product Owner or in a similar role, with responsibility for business-critical services or platforms.

• Extensive experience with Microsoft 365 collaboration technologies, including Microsoft Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, Exchange Online and Microsoft Entra-related dependencies.

• Experience with IT service management and governance, including service transition, incident and problem management, change management and continuous improvement.

• Experience leading cross-functional initiatives and translating business needs into practical, scalable IT solutions.

About the role and the team

You’ll own the lifecycle of GlobalConnect’s Collaboration & Productivity portfolio, including Microsoft 365, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, Exchange Online, Copilot and other strategic collaboration platforms. Your focus will be to keep these business-critical services secure, reliable and well managed, while continuously improving them and helping set the long-term direction for the area.

You’ll be part of the Digital Workplace organization, in a team of 17 colleagues with experience in IT support, system ownership and specialist roles. Working across business and IT, you’ll also partner with Security, Identity Governance & Administration, system owners and external suppliers. Your work will help ensure employees have effective tools for communication, meetings, document collaboration, knowledge sharing and everyday productivity.

What you’ll be working on

• Own the service lifecycle across the collaboration and productivity portfolio, ensuring clear governance, documentation, compliance and operational readiness.

• Define and monitor service-level objectives, availability and user experience; follow up on incidents and recurring problems and make improvements.

• Manage licensing, renewals, budget follow-up, cost control and supplier performance.

• Work with business and technical stakeholders to govern access, information sharing, external collaboration, retention and service lifecycles.

• Manage cross-functional change and adoption initiatives, identifying practical opportunities for automation, AI, standardization and better ways of working.

• Act as a subject matter expert and trusted advisor, connecting employee needs with operational, technical, security and strategic priorities.

Who we are looking for

You bring structure and a pragmatic approach to service management, and you’re comfortable moving between strategic development and day-to-day operational priorities. You build effective working relationships across business and technical teams, and can assess dependencies, risks and competing needs to move work forward. You’re curious about how collaboration services can evolve, including through responsible use of automation and AI.

Does this sound like you? If so, we’d like to hear from you.

jobs.occupation: Head of Center of Excellence for Project Management
jobs.description:
At Bavarian Nordic, we are committed to saving and improving lives by unlocking the power of the immune system. Our commercial portfolio includes market-leading vaccines against smallpox/mpox, rabies, tick-borne encephalitis, typhoid fever, and cholera. We excel in R&D innovation, manufacturing, and commercialization, working every day to protect people’s health and quality of life and protect our tomorrow.

We are looking for an experienced leader for the Head of Center of Excellence (project management) role in our Strategy Execution department who combines strategic thinking, strong change management capabilities, and a genuine passion for building organizational capability. In this role, you will not only define how projects are governed and delivered but also drive the adoption of new ways of working across a global organization.

**About The Role

**This is a broad and hands-on role spanning project leadership and organizational capability building within project excellence. A key aspect of the role is driving organizational change by ensuring that project management frameworks, tools, and processes are successfully adopted, understood, and embedded across the business. In this dual role, you will balance being Head of Center of Excellence while managing high-impact cross-functional projects yourself. Just as importantly, you will turn standards into practice by designing and delivering training, facilitating sessions, coaching colleagues, and creating engagement across the organization.

You will work across R&D, manufacturing, supply chain, commercial, and corporate functions. The portfolio may include merger and acquisition activities, development projects, vaccine launches, technology implementations, and other enterprise-wide transformation initiatives. Success requires someone who enjoys moving between strategic planning, practical implementation, and visible facilitation in front of an audience.

The position is based in Hellerup, Denmark. You will join a team of +20 Project Managers, Program Leads, and Student Assistants and report to the VP of Strategy Execution Office.

**Key Responsibilities

**

• Own and continuously strengthen project management standards, governance, tools, templates, and ways of working across the organization

• Lead complex, cross-functional strategic projects, including initiatives connected to M&A, product development, vaccine launches, and enterprise transformation

• Drive adoption of project management methodologies and support organizational change through stakeholder engagement, communication, training, and coaching

• Develop project management capability through structured training, facilitation, coaching, and hands-on knowledge sharing across different functions and seniority levels

• Serve as a visible ambassador for project excellence, translating methodology into clear, practical, and engaging learning experiences

• Partner with senior stakeholders to create alignment, transparency, sound decision-making, and clear ownership throughout the project lifecycle

• Drive disciplined planning, risk management, resource coordination, and execution, supported by strong use of project and portfolio management tools

**What You Bring

**You bring extensive experience leading complex projects within pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, vaccines, or another highly regulated healthcare environment. You also bring change management expertise combined with hands-on delivery experience. Besides this, we are looking for someone with the following background;

• A genuine interest in the full scope of project management excellence, from strategic framework design and governance to practical implementation and organizational training

• Strong presentation and facilitation skills, with the confidence and energy to stand in front of an audience, engage participants, and make complex methods practical and relevant

• Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders, create buy-in, and lead through complex global and cross-functional environments

• Strong knowledge of PMI-based project management practices. PMI/PMP certification is an advantage - other relevant certifications are also valued

• Experience with merger and acquisition projects

• A relevant master’s degree within life sciences, engineering, supply chain, business, or a related field

• Advanced expertise in Smartsheet combined with experience with Microsoft Project is an advantage

**Why join us?

**This role gives you the opportunity to influence both how strategic projects are delivered and how project management capability is built across Bavarian Nordic. You will combine high-impact project leadership with the chance to shape standards, develop colleagues, and create a lasting project excellence culture in a purpose-driven global vaccine organization.

If you are motivated by strategy and execution, enjoy building practical solutions, and feel energized by training and engaging others, we would love to hear from you.

**Caught your interest?

**Apply now and join Bavarian Nordic in our mission to improve health outcomes and foster sustainable growth.

We do not offer any relocation packages for this role. Please note that employment is contingent on residing and working in Denmark.

We kindly request that headhunters or recruitment agencies refrain from contacting us regarding this position.

_Bavarian Nordic is a global vaccine company with a mission to improve health and save lives through innovative vaccines. We are a preferred supplier of mpox and smallpox vaccines to governments to enhance public health preparedness and have a leading portfolio of travel vaccines. We are headquartered in Denmark and have manufacturing, research, and sales offices across Europe and North America.

__Bavarian Nordic is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applications will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against based on race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.

_For more information, visit www.bavarian-nordic.com

With more than 100 years of experience, we combine deep technology and manufacturing expertise with a strong global presence to design, produce, and deliver innovative moulded fibre products. In doing so, we provide sustainable packaging that helps feed the world – one carton at a time.

About Memtrace

AI coding agents are fast, but they forget. They lose context between sessions, repeat mistakes, and don't understand the codebase around them. Memtrace builds the memory layer that fixes this: a deterministic knowledge graph of your code, built with AST parsing rather than guesswork, that any coding agent can use. Our products include MemDB, MemFleet, Cortex, and a code review engine. We are backed by Antler and Innovation Fund Denmark, and we work with Google, AWS, and Microsoft for Startups.

The role

You will own revenue end to end: strategy, pipeline, pricing, partnerships, and the first commercial team. We have developer interest and active pilots with enterprise customers. Your job is to turn that into repeatable, paying adoption. At this stage you will do the selling yourself while building the playbook that others will follow.

What you will do

• 
Define and run the go-to-market motion: developers adopt, engineering leaders and budget-holders buy.

• 
Own the revenue number and the pipeline. Run discovery, demos, pilots, and negotiations personally.

• 
Convert pilots into contracts, with clear success criteria, pricing, and procurement paths.

• 
Set pricing and packaging for individual, team, and enterprise tiers.

• 
Build channel and ecosystem partnerships (cloud marketplaces, consultancies, industry bodies, AI-coding-tool vendors).

• 
Feed customer and market insight back to product and research, and help decide what we build next.

• 
Hire and lead the first commercial team (sales, solutions, customer success) when the time is right.

• 
Report on pipeline, conversion, and retention to the founders and investors.

What we are looking for

• 
8+ years in B2B software sales or commercial leadership, with at least one role in developer tools, data/AI infrastructure, or open-source-led products.

• 
A track record of closing enterprise deals yourself, ideally in the Nordics or wider Europe.

• 
Experience selling to both technical champions and executive buyers, and knowing how those conversations differ.

• 
Comfort with ambiguity: you have built a sales motion without an existing playbook, brand, or team.

• 
Enough technical depth to talk credibly with engineers about codebases, CI/CD, and AI agents.

• 
Strong written and spoken English; Danish or another Nordic language is a plus.

Nice to have

• 
Experience with PLG, usage-based pricing, or open-core models.

• 
Existing relationships with engineering leaders at Nordic enterprises.

• 
Experience with EU procurement, security reviews, and data-residency requirements.

What we offer

• 
A founding-team seat with real ownership of the commercial side of the company.

• 
Direct influence on product, positioning, and company direction.

• 
Hybrid work in Copenhagen, with a small and fast-moving team.

jobs.occupation: Associate Professor (non-tenured) in archaeometry at SDU in Odense
jobs.description:
A position as non-tenured Associate Professor in archaeometry is available from 1 May 2027 until 31 March 2030 at the Department of Physics Chemistry and Pharmacy, Faculty of Science, SDU in Odense.

About the research group and the project
The research group at which this position is posted is called CHART (Cultural Heritage and Archaeometric Research Team). Cultural Heritage and archaeometric research deal with investigations of samples originating from all sorts of culturally important artefacts: those procured by archaeologists in excavations, medieval buildings, handmade artefacts of all kinds, pieces of art, written materials. Only, the objects must have survived and be preserved today to some tangible degree. The study of cultural heritage is not exclusively for the humanities. In the last four or five decades, natural sciences have been increasingly involved in untangling the events of the past by studying cultural heritage objects to an ever-increasing degree of complexity. 

 

In CHART we take up the challenge of investigating cultural heritage objects on an international level using chemistry and physics. We aim at making a difference on the international scene by inventing new analytical methodologies, investigating objects of national and international interest, and by always securing collaboration between natural science and the humanities.

We do not claim to produce final or stand-alone answers; instead, we strive to achieve solutions together with colleagues from the humanities. In our research laboratories we daily cross the line between natural science and the humanities.

 

The present position is aimed at executing the already financed CIPP Center (Center for the Interior of Parchment and Paper), which involves the investigation of the Dead Sea Scrolls (https://www.sdu.dk/en/om-sdu/fakulteterne/naturvidenskab/nyheder-2026/erc-dead-sea-scrolls-archaeometry), the development of new methods for analysing paper and parchment, and a new project on poisonous books conducted in collaboration with the Royal Academy in Copenhagen, Pisa University, and the Library at SDU (https://www.nature.com/articles/s40494-019-0334-2 ).   

 

About the candidate
The successful candidate is expected to hold a PhD in archaeometry, analytical chemistry, or a closely related field, with a research profile centred on the application of analytical and physical-chemical methods to archaeological and heritage materials. A demonstrated expertise in a wide range of archaeomaterials (e.g., ceramics, bricks, pigments, and parchments) spanning diverse chrono-cultural contexts will be considered an asset. 

 

Tasks

• 
The candidate must partake in the execution of the research at the CIPP Center conducted by the CHART research group and contribute to the overall research theme of CHART. 

• 
The candidate must be able to support the ongoing collaboration with ADBOU at the SDU Health Faculty.

• 
The candidate is expected to obtain external funding for independent research, to foster internal collaboration at the Department, and to build and lead an internationally recognized research group. 

• 
The candidate should contribute to public outreach and communication activities.

• 
The candidate should teach (broadly) in degree programmes at the department, as well as participate in departmental administration, strategy development and educational programme development. 

• 
The candidate is expected to mentor undergraduate, graduate, and research students. 

 

Skills

• 
The candidate must have a strong and independent research profile, documented by an excellent track record of peer-reviewed publications in international journals. Hands-on experience with advanced analytical chemical instrumentation, experience with luminescence-based dating methods, and a demonstrated ability to develop or adapt analytical chemical methods will be highly valued.

• 
Experience with international collaboration, of partnerships with museums and cultural-heritage institutions, and of collaboration with the private sector will be an advantage.

• 
The successful candidate should have a strong teaching record. This includes experience with teaching courses within a chemistry curriculum at bachelor and master level as well as experience of project supervision across all levels, from bachelor to PhD. Experience with interdisciplinary, practical, and laboratory-based teaching, and with modern teaching methods, e-learning, flipped classroom, and online learning methods will be an advantage. A teaching CV should be included in the proposal. Teaching at the department includes first year teaching held in Danish, and the successful applicant may be expected to be involved in first year teaching. However, teaching in English is accepted from the start of employment, and the successful applicant is expected to learn basic Danish within 5 years. The university offers language courses.

The candidate will be part of the chemistry section. 

Application deadline: 15. November 2026 at 23:59 hours local Danish time

Please see the full call, including how to apply, on www.sdu.dk
